verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.pt: Mas Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Job answered,
verses.en_bbe: And Job made answer and said,

verses.en: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
verses.pt: Na verdade sei que é assim; mas como pode o ser humano ser justo diante de Deus?
verses.en_web: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I see that it is so: and how is it possible for a man to get his right before God?

verses.en: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.pt: Ainda se quisesse disputar com ele, não conseguiria lhe responder uma coisa sequer em mil.
verses.en_web: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
verses.en_bbe: If a man was desiring to go to law with him, he would not be able to give him an answer to one out of a thousand questions.

verses.en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
verses.pt: Ele é sábio de coração, e poderoso em forças. Quem se endureceu contra ele, e teve paz?
verses.en_web: God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him, and prospered?
verses.en_bbe: He is wise in heart and great in strength: who ever made his face hard against him, and any good came of it?

verses.en: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
verses.pt: Ele transporta as montanhas sem que o saibam; e as transtorna em seu furor.
verses.en_web: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
verses.en_bbe: It is he who takes away the mountains without their knowledge, overturning them in his wrath:

verses.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.pt: Ele remove a terra de seu lugar, e faz suas colunas tremerem.
verses.en_web: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.
verses.en_bbe: Who is moving the earth out of its place, so that its pillars are shaking:

verses.en: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
verses.pt: Ele dá ordem ao sol, e ele não brilha; e sela as estrelas.
verses.en_web: He commands the sun, and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
verses.en_bbe: Who gives orders to the sun, and it does not give its light; and who keeps the stars from shining.

verses.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
verses.pt: Ele é o que sozinho estende os céus, e anda sobre as alturas do mar.
verses.en_web: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
verses.en_bbe: By whose hand the heavens were stretched out, and who is walking on the waves of the sea:

verses.en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
verses.pt: Ele é o que fez a Usra, o Órion, as Plêiades, e as constelações do sul.
verses.en_web: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
verses.en_bbe: Who made the Bear and Orion, and the Pleiades, and the store-houses of the south:

verses.en: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
verses.pt: Ele é o que faz coisas grandes e incompreensíveis, e inúmeras maravilhas.
verses.en_web: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.
verses.en_bbe: Who does great things not to be searched out; yes, wonders without number.

verses.en: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.pt: Eis que ele passa diante de mim, sem que eu não o veja; ele passará diante de mim, sem que eu saiba.
verses.en_web: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
verses.en_bbe: See, he goes past me and I see him not: he goes on before, but I have no knowledge of him.

verses.en: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.pt: Eis que, quando ele toma, quem pode lhe impedir? Quem poderá lhe dizer: O que estás fazendo?
verses.en_web: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.en_bbe: If he puts out his hand to take, by whom may it be turned back? who may say to him, What are you doing?

verses.en: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
verses.pt: Deus não reverterá sua ira, e debaixo dele se encurvam os assistentes de Raabe.
verses.en_web: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
verses.en_bbe: God's wrath may not be turned back; the helpers of Rahab were bent down under him.

verses.en: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
verses.pt: Como poderia eu lhe responder, e escolher minhas palavras contra ele?
verses.en_web: How much less shall I answer him, And choose my words to argue with him?
verses.en_bbe: How much less may I give an answer to him, using the right words in argument with him?

verses.en: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.pt: A ele, ainda que eu fosse justo, não lhe responderia; a meu juiz pediria misericórdia.
verses.en_web: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.en_bbe: Even if my cause was good, I would not be able to give an answer; I would make request for grace from him who was against me.

verses.en: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
verses.pt: Ainda que eu lhe chamasse, e ele respondesse, mesmo assim não creria que ele tivesse dado ouvidos à minha voz.
verses.en_web: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
verses.en_bbe: If I had sent for him to be present, and he had come, I would have no faith that he would give ear to my voice.

verses.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.pt: Pois ele tem me quebrantado com tempestade, e multiplicado minhas feridas sem causa.
verses.en_web: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.
verses.en_bbe: For I would be crushed by his storm, my wounds would be increased without cause.

verses.en: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
verses.pt: Ele não me permite respirar; em vez disso, me farta de amarguras.
verses.en_web: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
verses.en_bbe: He would not let me take my breath, but I would be full of bitter grief.

verses.en: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
verses.pt: Quanto às forças, eis que ele é forte; e quanto ao juízo, ele diria: Quem me convocará?
verses.en_web: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
verses.en_bbe: If it is a question of strength, he says, Here I am! and if it is a question of a cause at law, he says, Who will give me a fixed day?

verses.en: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
verses.pt: Ainda que eu seja justo, minha boca me condenaria; se eu fosse inocente, então ela me declararia perverso.
verses.en_web: Though I am righteous, my own mouth shall condemn me. Though I am blameless, it shall prove me perverse.
verses.en_bbe: Though I was in the right, he would say that I was in the wrong; I have done no evil; but he says that I am a sinner.

verses.en: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
verses.pt: Mesmo se eu for inocente, não estimo minha alma; desprezo minha vida.
verses.en_web: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.
verses.en_bbe: I have done no wrong; I give no thought to what becomes of me; I have no desire for life.

verses.en: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
verses.pt: É tudo a mesma coisa; por isso digo: ele consome ao inocente e ao perverso.
verses.en_web: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: It is all the same to me; so I say, He puts an end to the sinner and to him who has done no wrong together.

verses.en: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
verses.pt: Quando o açoite mata de repente, ele ri do desespero dos inocentes.
verses.en_web: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.
verses.en_bbe: If death comes suddenly through disease, he makes sport of the fate of those who have done no wrong.

verses.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
verses.pt: A terra está entregue nas mãos dos perversos. Ele cobre o rosto de seus juízes. Se não é ele, então quem é?
verses.en_web: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
verses.en_bbe: The land is given into the power of the evil-doer; the faces of its judges are covered; if not by him, then who has done it?

verses.en: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
verses.pt: Meus dias foram mais rápidos que um homem que corre; fugiram, e não viram o bem.
verses.en_web: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away, they see no good.
verses.en_bbe: My days go quicker than a post-runner: they go in flight, they see no good.

verses.en: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
verses.pt: Passaram como barcos de papiro, como a águia que se lança à comida.
verses.en_web: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.
verses.en_bbe: They go rushing on like reed-boats, like an eagle dropping suddenly on its food.

verses.en: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
verses.pt: Se disser: Esquecerei minha queixa, mudarei o aspecto do meu rosto, e sorrirei,
verses.en_web: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up;’
verses.en_bbe: If I say, I will put my grief out of mind, I will let my face be sad no longer and I will be bright;

verses.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
verses.pt: Ainda teria pavor de todas as minhas dores; pois sei que não me terás por inocente.
verses.en_web: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that you will not hold me innocent.
verses.en_bbe: I go in fear of all my pains; I am certain that I will not be free from sin in your eyes.

verses.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
verses.pt: Se eu já estou condenado, então para que eu sofreria em vão?
verses.en_web: I shall be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?
verses.en_bbe: You will not let me be clear of sin! why then do I take trouble for nothing?

verses.en: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
verses.pt: Ainda que me lave com água de neve, e limpe minhas mãos com sabão,
verses.en_web: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
verses.en_bbe: If I am washed with snow water, and make my hands clean with soap;

verses.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.pt: Então me submergirias no fosso, e minhas próprias vestes me abominariam.
verses.en_web: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.en_bbe: Then you will have me pushed into the dust, so that I will seem disgusting to my very clothing.

verses.en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
verses.pt: Pois ele não é homem como eu, para que eu lhe responda, e venhamos juntamente a juízo.
verses.en_web: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
verses.en_bbe: For he is not a man as I am, that I might give him an answer, that we might come together before a judge.

verses.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.pt: Não há entre nós árbitro que ponha sua mão sobre nós ambos,
verses.en_web: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.
verses.en_bbe: There is no one to give a decision between us, who might have control over us.

verses.en: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
verses.pt: Tire de sobre mim sua vara, e seu terror não me espante.
verses.en_web: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;
verses.en_bbe: Let him take away his rod from me and not send his fear on me:

verses.en: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
verses.pt: Então eu falaria, e não teria medo dele. Pois não está sendo assim comigo.
verses.en_web: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
verses.en_bbe: Then I would say what is in my mind without fear of him; for there is no cause of fear in myself.
